_what: Specs that MUST execute in every CI run. The suite-wide zero-spec guard cannot see an individual spec going back to skipping; this list can. Enforced by tests/e2e/scripts/assert-specs-ran.mjs.
_how_to_add: Add the spec path to "required". Paths are matched against the Playwright JSON report by path suffix, so either tests/e2e/foo.spec.ts or foo.spec.ts works.
